Aisha Khan: Heads-up — QBR next Wed 10am PT. Need to recalibrate partner health, tiers, and MDF asks before the deck. I want a short, operational set of asks not a long strategy doc.
Tom Liu: Timeline? can we get a slide outline by Thu so we can iterate Fri?
Maya Patel: Agreed. Proposing: scorecard v2 (simpler metrics), a marketplace credit pilot, and a hardware credits line item for co-funded POCs. I'll draft the MDF reallocation rationale.
Rafael Gomez: Finance check: reallocating is doable but we need explicit line items and partner commitment letters (CMPs). Quick table sketch below for Q2 pool: 
```
Category,Current,$,Proposed,$
Total MDF,1,000,000,1,000,000
Marketplace credits,50,000,200,000
Field events,300,000,240,000
Co-marketing pool,200,000,160,000
Reserve,450,000,400,000
```
Jonas: I can own the marketplace credit pilot. Will put together pilot T&Cs, measurement (CAC lift, time-to-close delta), and a 60-day cadence for reviews. :+1:
Priya Singh: For the partner SI demos we should include two short walkthroughs (5-min recorded clips) showing Redwood <> SI end-to-end. @eng-platform can we get a short-lived tenant for recordings?
Tom Liu: Also add one slide: hardware-backed routing case study (latency and cost delta) — show before/after numbers for GPU vs CPU fallback.
Maya Patel: FYI NVIDIA offered limited promotional GPU credits for a co-marketing push; if we pair MDF for POC match that strengthens asks. I'll include a proposed matching table.
Rafael Gomez: If vendor credits are coming in we can treat them as third-party match but need MOUs + utilization windows. Procurement needs partner IDs and expected spend profile.
PartnerOpsBot: Reminder — QBR slides due EOD Friday. Upload to https://redwood.app/slides/partners-qbr and tag @partnerships.
Aisha Khan: Action items (owners + due): 
- @Jonas: marketplace pilot terms + KPIs (Thu 5pm PT)
- @Maya: MDF reallocation slides + hardware credit note (Thu 5pm PT)
- @Priya: SI demo recordings + env request ticket link (post here)
- @Tom: one-slide latency/cost case study (Fri 12pm PT)
- @Rafael: finalize budget table + procurement/compliance checklist (Fri EOD)
Please drop slide stubs into the deck and ping me once added. Call out blockers now. :eyes:
Tom Liu: I'll take latency slide; will include simple graph and two bullet takeaways.
Jonas: Pilot stub uploaded to the deck (just a placeholder).
Priya Singh: Env request ticket created: https://support.redwood.internal/tickets/PRT-4821 — submitted for a short-lived tenant for demo recordings.
Rafael Gomez: I'll add a procurement checklist and a CSV export of the budget table to the slides folder.
Maya Patel: Adding the MDF rationale + an escalation path slide if partners ask for >commitments.
Aisha Khan: Great. We'll lock the final deck Fri 6pm PT and rehearse Mon morning. If anyone can't meet deliverables, flag it in-thread. Thanks. :calendar:
